name: streamtanks
description: Interactive Twitch chat artillery game and OBS browser overlay

scripts.build:prod: tsc --noEmit && esbuild web/src/game.ts --bundle --outfile=web/public/game.js --minify --sourcemap && esbuild ext-web/src/ext.ts --bundle --outfile=ext-web/public/ext.js --sourcemap && npm run build:sim && npm run build:lab
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:sim && npm run build:lab
scripts.package:ext: npm run build && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path ext-web/public/* -DestinationPath extension.zip -Force"
